content:
**Mutton Chops** are a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

Sheepsquatch Meat that has been cooked over a fire. It gives a 30 minute boost to Melee Damage while restoring a large amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Sheepsquatch Meat | | Mutton Chops (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the required ingredients after picking up Sheepsquatch Meat for the first time.
